''See also: [[Charity Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Charity is a [[Sage]] and a prominent leader within the [[Akura clan]], serving as one of its two primary pillars alongside [[Malice]]. A granddaughter of a former [[Monarch]], she rose to the rank of [[Archlord]] in her youth before becoming a [[Sage]]. Her leadership is defined by a deep commitment to the [[Akura clan|Akura]] philosophy, which emphasizes that the clan must be harsh and powerful to protect humanity from the dangers of the world. She is known for her legendary passion for human interests and her intense resentment toward factions led by [[sacred beasts]]. Charity possesses a dignified and calm presence, often appearing with a veiled spirit that prevents her aura from overwhelming others. She utilizes the [[Book of the Silver Heart]], which contains seven specific techniques involving dreams and shadows, and she has the ability to harvest and mold the essences of [[Remnants]] into various constructs. Despite her often expressionless or icy exterior, she is described as having a heart that can be easily swayed by emotion. She maintains significant [[Authority|authority]], commanding [[Archlord|Archlords]] and managing complex responsibilities such as monitoring the well-being of her people and overseeing clan resources during times of war and uncertainty.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Charity is a [[Sage]] with purple eyes who wears [[sacred arts]] robes. She is often seen with a [[silver-and-purple owl]] perched upon her shoulder.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|An [[Akura clan|Akura family]] member and [[Archlady]], Charity is a person who does not tolerate cheating and shows concern for the safety of teams. She maintains a [[The mask|mask]]-like expression and is motivated by her role as one of the two remaining pillars of the [[Akura clan|Akura family]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Charity is the daughter of [[Akura Fury]] and the granddaughter of [[Akura Malice]]. She is an acquaintance of [[Lindon]], whom she has trained and provided with various items, and she works alongside [[Min Shuei]] to manage [[Lindon]]'s training. Additionally, Charity is an aunt to the [[Akura clan|Akura family]] and has interacted with [[Mercy]], [[Yerin]], [[Yan Shoumei]], and [[Dross]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Charity utilizes a blend of [[shadow madra|shadow and dream madra]] to fuel her living [[Forger technique]], which involves communicating [[silver-and-purple owls]]. Her repertoire includes the [[Dream of Darkness]], mental [[Enforcer techniques]], and the Will-Heart Resonance technique. She also wields a silver sickle, a [[steel]] shield featuring a grinning face, and a [[liquid steel]] [[sacred instrument]] of concealment and banishment.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Charity maintained a masked expression while managing [[Lindon]]'s points and engaging in a private, unheard exchange with [[Uncle Fury]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c3">''Bloodline'', chapter 3</ref> As she prepared the exit for [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]], Charity expanded the [[Sky’s Edge gate]] into a broad screen of darkness using her [[void key]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4">''Bloodline'', chapter 4</ref> She utilized three sacred instruments, which included a silver sickle, a [[steel]] shield bearing the image of a grinning monster, and a [[liquid steel]] instrument for concealment and banishment.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4" /> To facilitate travel, she used a column of darkness and protected a string of ships with shields made of [[purple-and-silver madra]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4" /> Charity also utilized a communicating owl, provided information to [[Lindon]] and [[Dross]], and possessed the ability to open portals and bring techniques to life.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c4" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c5">''Bloodline'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9">''Bloodline'', chapter 9</ref> While she had not directly commanded [[Dreadgods]], [[Lindon]] noted that he would need to thank her upon their return.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6">''Bloodline'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c19">''Bloodline'', chapter 19</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Moongrave defense}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|While observing the city of [[Moongrave]] from across its expanse, Charity remains a member of the head family.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10">''Dreadgod'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12">''Dreadgod'', chapter 12</ref> Despite being over a hundred and fifty years old, she has never attempted to advance to the rank of [[Monarch]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12" /> Having reached the [[Archlord]] stage at a relatively young age before becoming a [[Sage]], she is bound by an oath to [[Akura Malice]] to keep the connection between [[Monarchs]] and [[Dreadgods]] secret without permission.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c12" /> During the [[Titan]]'s attack, she intervened to assist [[Lindon]] with his retreat.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref> Using her [[spiritual perception]] to sweep over the city, she employs the Will-Heart Resonance technique from her Book and can cleanse techniques with a silver flash from [[Min Shuei]]'s soul.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c16">''Dreadgod'', chapter 16</ref> A specialist in mental [[Enforcer techniques]], she carries a vibrating sickle and previously brought [[Mercy]] to [[Moongrave]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c23">''Dreadgod'', chapter 23</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Heart Icon connection}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As a lesser [[sacred artist]], Charity maintains a connection to the [[Heart Icon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref> While she struggles to withstand even a single attack from the [[Dreadgod weapon]], Charity has successfully awakened the [[Heart Icon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref> Her techniques are specifically suited for the role of a jailer, allowing her to overcome mental enhancements through the use of [[Script|script]] formation within a cell.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26" /> Charity appeared to be doing well during the combat against [[Shadow|shadow]] swords before she ultimately betrayed [[Malice]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Charity holds [[Authority|authority]] over the [[Ashwind continent]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 13</ref> In this role, she maintains control over her own territory.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13" />}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|“We have reason to worry for the safety of our teams,” Charity said.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“It is my sixth technique,” Charity confirmed.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" />}}

“The only direct descendant.”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“You will be busy before my father arrives,” Charity interrupted.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Then Charity swept in, one of her owls perched on her shoulder. “I’m afraid not. You’ll be accompanying my father back to Sky’s Edge immediately; we need him back in place without delay.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18" />}}
